excerpt.zh: 在发现神秘的未叙尊者的小行星古龛之后，首席科学官认为可能还有其他关于我们——或者自以为是我们——供奉的古神宫殿存在于附近的恒星系中。
excerpt.en: After the discovery of the mysterious asteroid-shrine to the Untold, top scientists have proposed that there may be additional shrines dedicated to our - or what we believed was only our - pantheon, in neighboring systems.

texts.en: After the discovery of the mysterious asteroid-shrine to the Untold, top scientists have proposed that there may be additional shrines dedicated to our - or what we believed was only our - pantheon, in neighboring systems.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

texts.zh:
恩赐女神神龛的每一面上都覆盖着由的象形文字组成的复杂网络，似乎在诉说着一个远比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的上古传说更加恢弘的故事。

即使只是与已知的古[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]语言有着些许的关系，只要有足够的时间和资源，在当代科技的帮助下，我们也可以解读这些象形文字。
texts.en:
Every surface of the Benefactress' shrine is covered with a complex web of pictograms, seemingly telling a story far more expansive than the lingering fables on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Though only distantly related to known ancient [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages: modern technology should allow us to decipher the pictograms, given enough time and resources.

title.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Benefactress

texts.zh:
破解恩赐女神神殿中的象形文字要比预计的顺利许多。负责该项目的语言学家们称，这些文本莫名地令人亲切：能轻易地“触动”他们的心弦，尽管其中的语法古老又冗杂。

然而，他们指出，这些信息暗示了一些非常晦涩难懂的主题和上下文。我们除非与关于这位四位一体的神的其他文本结合起来，否则很难完全理解他们的信息。
texts.en:
Deciphering the pictograms in the Benefactress' shrine went more smoothly than anticipated. The linguists assigned to the project describe these texts as somehow familiar: "clicking" easily for them, despite the grammar's age and complexity.

They note, however, these written messages allude to some truly obscure themes and contexts. We cannot fully understand their messages until they are combined with other texts associated with this quadrumvirate godhead.

texts.zh:
完整的众神教条——因为我们认为被恢复的文本就应该被这样视作——对我们具有启示意义，它对于我们古老宗教赖以建立的那些幻想基础是具有毁灭性的。

当放在以[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]为中心的情景中时，这些文本清楚地表明，我们注定要在一位宗教领袖强有力的手段的引导下实现伟大的功业。我们注定要成为神，但我们的过去充斥着流产的预言和因无知而产生的罪恶。救赎是短暂的。
texts.en:
The complete doctrine of the gods - for that is how we believe the recovered texts should be regarded - is as revelatory to us as it is devastating to the fantasies upon which our ancient religions were founded.

When placed within a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]-centered context, these texts make it clear that we were meant for greatness, guided by the strong hand of a religious leader. We are destined for godhood, but our past is littered with unfulfilled prophecies and sin born of ignorance. Redemption is ephemeral.

tooltips.zh: 知识就是力量。神秘的知识是神秘的力量。
tooltips.en: Knowledge is power. Secret knowledge is secret power.

label.zh: 我们可以拿这个换点钱。
但是我们能从中了解到什么？
label.en: But what can we learn from this?

label.zh: 我们追随神意的脚步前进！
label.en: We walk in the footsteps of the Divine!

note.zh: 四选一的收尾（压下发现、变现、研究、神恩），结束事件链。
note.en: A four-way finale (suppress, monetise, study, divine favour) that ends the chain.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出另一个在轨道上的物体与未叙尊者的古龛有很高的相似性。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system, where its crew report another object in orbit bearing strong resemblance to a shrine to the Untold.

texts.zh:
一如萦绕着祂的神话传说，供奉勇气之神神龛的神庙充满了无法确定来源与作用的装置。与简单的谜箱相去甚远，位于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的祂的神庙中四处充满着对力量的试炼，传说只有真正的贤者才读到祂的圣言。

我们先进的分析工具应该可以迅速破解这些密码。
texts.en:
The temple holding the Undaunted's shrine is - true to the myths surrounding him - filled with contraptions of indeterminate origin and purpose. A far cry from the simple puzzle-boxes and tests of strength that once filled his temples on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], it was once claimed that his holy texts could only be read by the truly worthy.

Our sophisticated analysis tools should make short work of these ciphers.

title.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Undaunted

texts.zh: 在经过了连日的仔细、甚至好几次令人崩溃的工作之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]取回了勇气之神的宗卷：一个普通的织物卷轴用用坚固塑料膜封存。这个卷轴被带回[Root.GetName]进行进一步研究。
texts.en: After days of careful, and at times excruciating effort, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has retrieved the Doctrine of the Undaunted: a humble textile scroll coated with a sturdy plastic polymer. The scroll has been brought back to the [Root.GetName] for further analysis.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员们本以为搜寻洞察女神的神殿会更费功夫一些，没想到刚一进入[Root.GetStarName]就看到了非常明显的指引。这个星系中的星体上被雕刻着人工矿物的图案，纷纷指向了一片中央区域。
texts.en: Expecting perhaps for a more difficult search when scanning for the shrine to the Percipient, the crew of [Root.GetName] were not ready to see it obviously signposted when entering [Root.GetStarName]. Artificial mineral patterns have been carved around on stellar bodies in the systems pointing to a central location.

texts.zh:
放置着洞察女神神像的洞室，其外墙被一层层厚重的金属漆所覆盖，但神像本身却是光秃秃的。

洞察女神的传说只会告诉那些能够理解这些传说的人——只有足够敏锐的人才能分辨哪些东西是真正需要领会的。
texts.en:
The walls housing this shrine to the Percipient are coated with thick layers of a mineral-based lacquer, but the shrine itself is bare.

The tales of the Percipient are told only to those perceptive enough to understand their meaning - it is just a matter of figuring out what needs to be perceived.

title.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Percipient

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报了有关洞察女神神殿的情况。

它的墙壁上镶嵌着表语文字，被一层层的保护漆严重地扭曲了。工作人员试图初步破译这种文字，但是失败了；它的语法与我们遇到的其他语言体系截然不同。[Root.GetName]的船员试图去除保护漆，希望能看得更加清楚，但没有成功。

在任务即将宣布失败的时候——在恼怒即将爆发的边缘——[Root.GetLeaderName]突然开始感知到一段段的连贯文本。

船员们没有花很长时间就利用这些线索编成了索引。很快，他们就把天花板、墙壁和地板描绘成了一个螺旋形的图案：这是一幅更广泛的图画的一部分，我们相信可以用其他神殿的文字来完成。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has reported back from the Percipient's shrine.

Its walls are inlaid with logographic script, heavily distorted by layers of a protective lacquer. Initial attempts to decipher this text failed; its grammar is too distinct from other linguistic groups we've encountered. The crew of the [Root.GetName] tried removing the protective lacquer for a clearer view, but to no avail.

The mission was about to be declared a failure when - on the cusp of an irritated outburst - [Root.GetLeaderName] suddenly began to perceive discrete lines of coherent text.

It did not take the crew long to utilize these insights as a codex. Soon they had the ceiling, walls and floor imaged in a spiral pattern: part of a broader picture which we believe may be completed using texts from the other shrines.

summary.text:
# 古神神殿 / Shrines to the Old Gods

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：events/anomaly_events_1.txt:1735-1880 (anomaly.140, chain start; story anomaly-ast-shrine-1-cat); common/event_chains (old_gods_chain, counter shrines_searched max 3); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:1927 (anomaly.142); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:1970 (anomaly.143); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:2013 (anomaly.144); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1015-1017 (on_entering_system_fleet); common/special_projects/00_projects_2.txt:114 (OLD_GODS_*_PROJECT); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:2056 (anomaly.165); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:2097 (anomaly.166); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:2138 (anomaly.167); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:2179 (anomaly.168)

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链“古神神殿”由异常 AST_SHRINE_1_CAT（“被雕琢的小行星”，另一故事 anomaly-ast-shrine-1-cat）的 anomaly.140“熟悉的古龛”选项b开启：它在最多8-10跳内的无殖民、无海盗、非敌对系统中选出三座神殿（标志 old_gods_system_1/2/3@拥有者），并创建三个兴趣点。

The event chain "Shrines to the Old Gods" is started by option b of anomaly.140 "Familiar Shrine" from the anomaly AST_SHRINE_1_CAT ("An Asteroid, Carved", another story, anomaly-ast-shrine-1-cat): it picks three uncolonised, pirate-free, non-hostile systems within 8-10 jumps as shrine systems (flags old_gods_system_1/2/3@owner) and creates three points of interest.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

三座神殿可按任意顺序拜访：舰队进入神殿所在系统（on_entering_system_fleet）→ anomaly.142“古神：接近恩赐女神” / 143“接近勇气之神” / 144“接近洞察女神”：创建神殿环境物体，启用对应项目（OLD_GODS_BENEFACTRESS/UNDAUNTED/PERCIPIENT，各90天；社会/工程/物理方向；需要科学船+科学家）。项目完成 → anomaly.165/166/167“…的神殿”：事件链计数 +1。三座都完成后触发 anomaly.168“古神：揭示”。

The three shrines can be visited in any order: a fleet entering a shrine system (on_entering_system_fleet) → anomaly.142 "Old Gods: Approaching the Benefactress" / 143 "Approaching the Undaunted" / 144 "Approaching the Percipient": creates the shrine ambient object and enables the matching project (OLD_GODS_BENEFACTRESS / UNDAUNTED / PERCIPIENT, 90 days each; society / engineering / physics; science ship and scientist). Finishing a project → anomaly.165/166/167 "Shrine to ..." adds 1 to the chain counter. Once all three are done, anomaly.168 "Old Gods: Revelation" fires.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三座神殿并行，无先后；anomaly.168 的四个选项互斥：a 压下发现（每月影响力，结束事件链）、b 变现（每月能量）、c 研究（每月社会研究）、d 神恩（团结并转向灵性，狂热灵性者改为更高团结）。

The three shrines are parallel; the four options of anomaly.168 are alternatives: a suppress (monthly influence, ends the chain), b monetise (monthly energy), c study (monthly society research), d divine favour (unity and a shift toward spiritualist; fanatic spiritualists get more unity).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

开启事件链的 anomaly.140 对狂热灵性者有不同选项（直接结束链）；168 的选项d按是否狂热灵性者变化。

anomaly.140, which starts the chain, has a different option for fanatic spiritualists (it ends the chain at once); 168's option d depends on being a fanatic spiritualist.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对 anomaly.140、142–144、165–168、三个项目与事件链。修正：草稿把三座神殿拆成三个各自以共享的 anomaly.168 收尾的故事；现合为一个以事件链“古神神殿”为起点的故事，三座神殿作为并行组，门控 anomaly.168。anomaly.140 属另一故事（c3b），仅作入口说明。

Checked anomaly.140, 142-144, 165-168, the three projects and the chain. Correction: the draft made three separate stories that all end in the shared anomaly.168; they are now one story starting from the chain "Shrines to the Old Gods" with the three shrines as a parallel group gating anomaly.168. anomaly.140 belongs to another story (c3b) and is only described as the entry.
